# trust-security

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-001 — A document outside a trusted folder opens read-only and keeps the viewing actions](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-001.md) — When a reader previews a document in an untrusted workspace or a file outside every workspace folder, the Studio SHALL show the rendered document read-only, without any control that edits it, refuse with a reason any change that is asked for and write nothing, while zooming, changing the theme, following links and copying code work as in a writable preview.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-004 — Local files load only from the allowed folders](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-004.md) — When a reader previews a document and it refers to a local image, media file or script, the Studio SHALL load it only from the folders the preview may read, whatever the spelling of the path, which for a file outside every workspace folder is its own folder and nothing else.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-006 — The preview runs no foreign code and unsafe HTML is made inert](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-006.md) — When a reader previews any document, the Studio SHALL keep the preview page from running scripts the Studio did not write, from loading anything from the network and from reading files outside the allowed folders, running no script that an untrusted workspace document carries and removing or neutralising unsafe raw HTML before the page shows it.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-009 — What the page and the host exchange is checked and never applied to another version](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-009.md) — When the preview page asks the extension to do something or the extension sends an answer to the page, the Studio SHALL check the request before anything changes, leave the page unchanged for an answer meant for another document or an older page, and never apply a message about an older render to a newer one.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-012 — Visible text and the icon speak of the product](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-012.md) — When the Studio shows a text to the reader or appears in the Extensions view, the Studio SHALL speak of the product, never naming its internal build tool and showing its own icon.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-014 — The extension is built from pinned dependencies and ships what it loads](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-014.md) — When a maintainer installs, builds and packages the Studio, the Studio SHALL be built from pinned, official dependencies and keep in its package the bundles the preview loads.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
